ValidationRule.description: Validate Account Address Postal Code format
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), OR ( AND( ISPICKVAL( BillingCountryCode , "BR"), !REGEX( BillingPostalCode ,"^(\\d{5}\\-\\d{3})?$") ), LEN( BillingPostalCode ) > 10 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Postal Code should not exceed 10 characters. For Brazil, please adjust ZIP/Postal Code format to: 00000-000
